snippet.title: [NP] PMWC at EWC 26 Finals D2 | PUBG MOBILE WORLD CUP at 2026 ESPORTS WORLD CUP
snippet.description:
Paris. $3,000,000. One Crown. PUBG MOBILE World Cup at 2026 Esports World Cup ko Finals jari chha!

PUBG MOBILE World Cup at 2026 Esports World Cup ko ultimate stage Finals ko Day 2 aaja Paris ma suru hudai chha! Dherai dinko fierce competition pachi, world ka top 16 teams le glory, legacy ra $3,000,000 prize pool ko sabai bhanda thulo hissa ko lagi ladna aafno thau secure gareka chan.

Yo nai ho tyo moment jasko lagi harek team le grind gareko thiyo, ra euta din ko battle pahilai sakisakeko chha. Group Stage ka best teams ra Survival Stage bata survive gareka teams aba feri ekpatak barsako sabai bhanda intense showdown ma head-to-head bhidnechan. Tin din, SMASH RULE, ra euta champion.

Journey aaja jhan uchai ma pugchha, kina bhane antim ma trophy uthaera PUBG MOBILE history ma aafno naam lekhaune team keval euta matra hunechha. Finals ko Day 2 suru Vayo!

🔥SMASH RULE kasari kaam garchha?
Finals ko Day 2 pachi, Match Point Threshold #1 ranked team ko points +10 ma set garincha. Yo threshold reach gareko team le tyaspachi ko kunai match jitnu parchha trophy claim garna. Threshold reach gareko tei match jitda championship jitidaina. Yedi Match 18 samma kunai team le SMASH RULE anusaar title secure garna sakena bhane, standard rules anusaar sabai bhanda dherai total points bhayeko team champion hunechha.

🔥 Kina tapaile PMWC at EWC 26 miss garnu hudaina:

- Paris ma world ko top PUBG MOBILE teams haru glory ko lagi battle gareko hernuhos!
- Pratyek match le race ma impact parne high-stakes action ko experience garnuhos!
- Aafno favorite region ra team lai $3,000,000 ra crown ko lagi cheer garnuhos!
- Finals ma exciting SMASH RULE format!

Group Stage: August 6–9
Survival Stage: August 11–12

Try PUBG MOBILE now: https://pubgmobile.go.link/26pmwc

snippet.title: Yabesh Thapa - Tadha ft. Oshin Karki | OFFICIAL MUSIC VIDEO
snippet.description:
I made Tadha almost four years ago and was obsessed with the idea, but I felt stuck at the same time. I knew I wanted to write a song that justifies loving someone from a distance, because the people we love can't always be by our side. Even though the song is called Tadha and carries a certain sadness, I wanted it to feel warm, fun, and full of love, but I just couldn't figure out how to finish it. It wasn't until I started working on GhaamChhaya that I finally found the motivation to complete it. Oshin graced the song with her beautiful voice, making it even more special. Fast forward a couple of years, we finally got to make a fun video for Tadha, and we hope you guys enjoy it as much as we enjoyed making it !

This one is for all the tadha batai maya garne mayalus !

Written, Composed, and Performed by Yabesh Thapa & Oshin Karki
Produced by Yabesh Thapa
Mixed and Mastered by SNJV

Visuals by Noisy

snippet.title: Sheetal | Official Music Video
snippet.description:
Sheetal - a sweet summer love story of “Ritu” and “Mausam”. 

Ritu arrives in a new city and meets Mausam, and they fall into a whirlwind romance that feels like it could last forever. But fate had other plans. When Ritu returns to find him, she is met with the cold truth of Mausam’s passing.

He may have left the world, but the feeling of him—the laughter in the ride, the warmth of his hand, the shade he offered in her hottest moments—refuses to fade. This video is a meditation on how the shortest chapters often leave the deepest imprints. Some loves don't need a lifetime to become eternal; they just need to be real.

Welcome to the PUBG MOBILE World Cup At 2026 Esports World Cup Finals Day 3 Map Feed! 
This stream provides a real-time map-only view, allowing you to track team rotations, zone shifts, and strategic movements as they unfold.

This is it the last matches of PMWC at EWC 26. The world’s best 16 teams have given everything, but only one will lift the trophy and take home the lion’s share of the $3,000,000 prize pool. Every rotation, every zone, and every elimination today could change the outcome of the entire championship because, now a team can win with SMASH RULE.

🔥 How does SMASH RULE work? 
On the last day of the PMWC at EWC 26 Finals, we have the Match Point Threshold! In Overall Ranking after 12th match, #1 ranked team’s points +10. Any team that hits this must then win a later match to claim the trophy winning the same match where they reach the threshold doesn’t bring the championship. If no team secures the title via SMASH Rule by Match 18, the team with the highest total points wins under standard rules.

snippet.title: Karma Unplugged Chapter 01 'YANIMAYA'
snippet.description:
KARMA UNPLUGGED

CHAPTER 01 — YaniMaya

Originally released in 2007 (Album- Karma), YaniMaya is one of Karma’s memorable songs. Almost two decades later, the song returns in a different form - unplugged, bringing a new texture to a song many have known for years.

FILMED AT — JAYA MANOHAR VIHAR

ललितपुर महानगरपालिका वडा नं. ८ मा रहेको यस इन्द्र देव संस्कारित जय मनोहर महाविहार आज भन्दा लगभग १००० वर्ष अघि स्थापना भएको इतिहास रहेको छ। लिच्छविकालमा भएको भिषण आगलागीमा काठमाडौं उपत्यकाको विशालनगर ध्वस्त भए पश्चात् यो विहार स्थानान्तरण हुँदै हालको स्थानमा स्थापना भएको इतिहास र किम्बदन्तीमा उल्लेख गरेको पाइन्छ। हाल यस विहारको चलन चल्तीको नाम सुबहाल रहेकोछ।

विहार स्थापना हुनु अघि यहाँ मसान रहेको मानिन्छ र यसको अवशेष हाल सम्म विहारको मध्य भागमा रहेको देख्न सकिन्छ।

यस विहारको विशेषता भनेको यहाँ विराजमान महाकाललाई टुँडिखेलको महानवमीको राति दिइने माछुको मासुको आहुति दिने परम्परा रहेको छ। उक्त रात बुढु र आइमाईहरूको उपस्थितिमा आहुति दिन इच्छुक व्यक्तिले विधिवत रूपमा आफ्नो शरीरको मासु / छाला चढाउन सक्ने परम्परा हाल समय यथावत नै रहेको छ।

A heartfelt thank you to the Jaya Manohar Vihar Committee for allowing us to bring this chapter to life at this historic space, and to our production and management teams for making the journey possible.

This is KARMA UNPLUGGED — CHAPTER 01: YaniMaya.

©️ 2026 Karma Band
Managed by ASQ

ललितपुर महानगरपालिका वडा नं. ८ मा रहेको यस इन्द्र देव संस्कारित जय मनोहर महाविहार आज भन्दा लगभग १००० वर्ष अघि स्थापना भएको इतिहास रहेको छ। लिच्छविकालमा भएको भिषण आगलागीमा काठमाडौं उपत्यकाको विशालनगर ध्वस्त भए पश्चात् यो विहार स्थानान्तरण हुँदै हालको स्थानमा स्थापना भएको इतिहास र किम्बदन्तीमा उल्लेख गरेको पाइन्छ। हाल यस विहारको चलन चल्तीको नाम सुबहाल रहेकोछ।

विहार स्थापना हुनु अघि यहाँ मसान रहेको मानिन्छ र यसको अवशेष हाल सम्म विहारको मध्य भागमा रहेको देख्न सकिन्छ।

यस विहारको विशेषता भनेको यहाँ विराजमान महाकाललाई टुँडिखेलको महानवमीको राति दिइने माछुको मासुको आहुति दिने परम्परा रहेको छ। उक्त रात बुढु र आइमाईहरूको उपस्थितिमा आहुति दिन इच्छुक व्यक्तिले विधिवत रूपमा आफ्नो शरीरको मासु / छाला चढाउन सक्ने परम्परा हाल समय यथावत नै रहेको छ।

A heartfelt thank you to the Jaya Manohar Vihar Committee for allowing us to bring this chapter to life at this historic space, and to our production and management teams for making the journey possible.

This is KARMA UNPLUGGED — CHAPTER 01: YaniMaya.

snippet.title: Prateek khadka - Sajilai Birsideu - Official Lyric Video
snippet.description:
Written/Composed/Performed : Prateek Khadka

Some goodbyes are never spoken, they are quietly carried within the heart.

“सजिलै बिर्सिदेऊ” is an intimate reflection on the paradox of unconditional love, where the deepest form of affection is found not in possession, but in release. The song explores the emotional duality of longing and acceptance, portraying a soul that chooses to preserve love through sacrifice rather than expectation. While memories continue to inhabit every corner of the heart, silently blesses the one they love with peace, happiness, and a future beyond themselves.

Each verse unfolds the quiet aftermath of separation, where lingering memories become both a burden and a sanctuary. It speaks of a love that transcends distance, survives silence, and finds permanence in remembrance rather than reunion. The recurring plea, “सजिलै बिर्सिदेऊ” is not an invitation to erase the past, but the ultimate expression of selfless devotion allowing someone to move forward while carrying the weight of every memory alone.

This song is dedicated to everyone who has discovered that the purest love is sometimes expressed through letting go, even when the heart never truly learns how to forget.

Thank you for everything.

Produced/Mixing : Suman Tamang (NMI Production)

snippet.title: Nazar Lagi Official Music Video | Akanksha Choudhary | Goldie Sohel | Asees Kaur | Noor | New Music
snippet.description:
Some love stories aren't meant to end because love fades. They end because fate has other plans. Nazar Lagi featuring Akanksha Choudhary is a heartbreak ballad by Goldie Sohel and Asees Kaur that captures the silent ache of two hearts deeply in love, yet separated by circumstances beyond their control. It is a story of longing, memories that refuse to fade, and the unbearable pain of watching love slip away despite never wanting to let go.

Credits :
Singers - Goldie Sohel & Asees Kaur 
Music Composer  - Goldie Sohel 
Lyrics - Noor 
Music Produced & Arranged - Goldie Sohel 
Additional Music Producer - Bitopan Baruah

snippet.title: BANGER (Official Music Video)  Badshah x Sharvi x Hiten ft Aveera Singh | #desihiphop
snippet.description:
Banger is all about the energy, the attitude, and the madness. Turn up the volume and add this fun track in your playlist now.

#banger  #badshah  #badshahnewsong  #desihiphop  #indianhiphop  #newhindisong  

Lyrics:-
Ho Ladke super man
Naa koi team naa koi plan
Ho duniya horahi fan
Yaa toh banger yaa phir ban 

Ho Ladke super man
Naa koi team naa koi plan
Ho duniya horahi fan
Yaa toh banger yaa phir ban 

Bhai tere bas likhta gaane
Aur duniya deti taane
Waise inhe dikkat par jab gaana baje lage sab sar hilane
Show ki inhe chahiye ticketein chahe hone de na show ko
Aise mujhe gaali bakte par insta pe mere saath hi chahiye photo
Ghadi dheere chalti hum tez chalte 
Bhar daala O2 inke face bante
Inke career se lambe humpe case chalte
Aye...
Jab nikle traffic jam 
Sar pe baabe ka hand 
Joh kaam kiye woh grand 
Yaa toh banger yaa phir _____

Ho Ladke super man
Naa koi team naa koi plan
Ho duniya horahi fan
Yaa toh banger yaa phir ban 

Naa nashe kiye naa daaru pi
Bin baat ke ban gaye aaropi
Double R to shauk se rakhi hai
Par aaj bhi ghar pe maruti
Kabhi private jet kabhi indigo
Sabse uppar meri hindi ho
Aur aaj bhi uska tod nahi
Bandi joh lagati bindi ho
Are baby understand 
Ab naam bana hai brand
Jab chahe karte land
Ya to banger ya phir _____

Ho Ladke super man
Naa koi team naa koi plan
Ho duniya horahi fan
Yaa toh banger yaa phir ban
 
Its your boy Badshah

snippet.title: [WATCHPARTY] PMWC at EWC FINALS DAY 3 | WITH 4K GAMING NEPAL
snippet.description:
"Paris. $3,000,000. One Crown. PUBG MOBILE World Cup at 2026 Esports World Cup ko Finals jari chha!

PUBG MOBILE World Cup at 2026 Esports World Cup ko ultimate stage Finals ko Day 2 aaja Paris ma suru hudai chha! Dherai dinko fierce competition pachi, world ka top 16 teams le glory, legacy ra $3,000,000 prize pool ko sabai bhanda thulo hissa ko lagi ladna aafno thau secure gareka chan.

Yo nai ho tyo moment jasko lagi harek team le grind gareko thiyo, ra euta din ko battle pahilai sakisakeko chha. Group Stage ka best teams ra Survival Stage bata survive gareka teams aba feri ekpatak barsako sabai bhanda intense showdown ma head-to-head bhidnechan. Tin din, SMASH RULE, ra euta champion.

Journey aaja jhan uchai ma pugchha, kina bhane antim ma trophy uthaera PUBG MOBILE history ma aafno naam lekhaune team keval euta matra hunechha. Finals ko Day 2 suru Vayo!

🔥SMASH RULE kasari kaam garchha?
Finals ko Day 2 pachi, Match Point Threshold #1 ranked team ko points +10 ma set garincha. Yo threshold reach gareko team le tyaspachi ko kunai match jitnu parchha trophy claim garna. Threshold reach gareko tei match jitda championship jitidaina. Yedi Match 18 samma kunai team le SMASH RULE anusaar title secure garna sakena bhane, standard rules anusaar sabai bhanda dherai total points bhayeko team champion hunechha.

🔥 Kina tapaile PMWC at EWC 26 miss garnu hudaina:

- Paris ma world ko top PUBG MOBILE teams haru glory ko lagi battle gareko hernuhos!
- Pratyek match le race ma impact parne high-stakes action ko experience garnuhos!
- Aafno favorite region ra team lai $3,000,000 ra crown ko lagi cheer garnuhos!
- Finals ma exciting SMASH RULE format!

Group Stage: August 6–9
Survival Stage: August 11–12
Finals: August 14–16

snippet.title: इकरार हो ना जाए | Zinda Dil | Udit Narayan Songs | Abbas | Ashima Bhalla
snippet.description:
उदित नारायण की मखमली आवाज और 2000 के दशक का वह जादुई दौर, जब संगीत का मतलब सिर्फ प्यार और सुकून हुआ करता था। 'इकरार हो ना जाए' फिल्म 'जिंदा दिल' का एक ऐसा ही खूबसूरत नगमा है जो सीधे दिल में उतर जाता है। यह गाना उस दौर की सादगी और रोमांस को बखूबी दर्शाता है।



Credits :

Song: Ikrar Ho Na Jaye
Album: Zinda Dil
Artist: Udit Narayan
Music Director: Nadeem-Shravan
Lyricist: Sameer 



Lyrics :

O ho ho ey hey hey
Iqaraar ho na jaaye
Izahaar ho na jaaye
Izahaar ho na jaaye
Izahaar ho na jaaye
Is mausam mein kahin
Mujhe pyaar ho na jaaye
O ho ho hey hey hey hey
Hey hey hey.. Hey hey hey hey


Saagar ki maujein hain
Khulaa aasmaan hai
Dhadkan deevaani hai
Dilkash samaa hai
Dhadkan deevaani hai
Dilkash samaa hai
Khvaabon ke hamsafar
Kaa deedaar ho na jaaye
Khvaabon ke hamsafar
Kaa deedaar ho na jaaye
Is mausam mein kahin
Mujhe pyaar ho na jaaye
O ho ho ho ho ho
Hey hey hey.. Hey hey hey hey


Jee chaahe lahron se
Karoon main sharaarat
Inko bataa doon main
Mere dil ki chaahat
Inko bataa doon main
Mere dil ki chaahat
Koi deevaanaa meraa
Dildaar ho na jaaye
Koi deevaanaa meraa
Dildaar ho na jaaye
Is mausam mein kahin
Mujhe pyaar ho na jaaye
O ho ho hey hey hey hey
O ho ho hey hey hey hey
Iqaraar ho na jaaye
Izahaar ho na jaaye
Is mausam mein kahin
Mujhe pyaar ho na jaaye
Hey hey hey.. Ey hey hey
O ho ho ey hey hey.

इस दिलकश गाने को सुनकर आपको भी अपनी पुरानी यादें ताजा हो जाएंगी। अगर आपको यह गाना पसंद आया, तो वीडियो को लाइक करें, अपने पसंदीदा रोमांटिक गाने का नाम कमेंट में बताएं और हमारे चैनल को सब्सक्राइब करना न भूलें।

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community.  Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

La sua particolarità è che praticamente tutto su ROBLOX è progettato e costruito dai membri della community. Ogni giocatore inizia scegliendo un avatar e dandogli un'identità. Può quindi esplorare ROBLOX, interagendo con gli altri tramite chat, giocando o collaborando a progetti creativi. रोब्लॉक्स क्या है? रोब्लॉक्स एक ऑनलाइन वर्चुअल प्लेग्राउंड और वर्कशॉप है, जहाँ सभी उम्र के बच्चे सुरक्षित रूप से एक-दूसरे से बातचीत कर सकते हैं, कुछ नया बना सकते हैं, मज़े कर सकते हैं और सीख सकते हैं। इसकी खासियत यह है कि रोब्लॉक्स पर लगभग हर चीज़ कम्युनिटी के सदस्यों द्वारा डिज़ाइन और निर्मित की जाती है। हर खिलाड़ी एक अवतार चुनकर और उसे एक पहचान देकर शुरुआत करता है। फिर वे रोब्लॉक्स को एक्सप्लोर कर सकते हैं - दूसरों के साथ चैट करके, गेम खेलकर या रचनात्मक प्रोजेक्ट्स पर सहयोग करके बातचीत कर सकते हैं। हर खिलाड़ी को एक अविकसित वर्चुअल ज़मीन का टुकड़ा मिलता है, साथ ही एक वर्चुअल टूलबॉक्स भी मिलता है जिससे वे कुछ भी डिज़ाइन और बना सकते हैं - चाहे वह चलने-फिरने लायक गगनचुंबी इमारत हो, एक चलता-फिरता हेलीकॉप्टर हो, एक विशाल पिनबॉल मशीन हो, एक मल्टीप्लेयर "कैप्चर द फ्लैग" गेम हो या कोई और, अभी तक सोचा भी न गया क्रिएशन। वर्चुअल ज़मीन के इस पहले टुकड़े के लिए कोई कीमत नहीं है। भाग लेकर और शानदार चीज़ें बनाकर, रोब्लॉक्स सदस्य स्पेशल बैज कमा सकते हैं। साथ ही ROBLOX डॉलर ("Robux") भी। बदले में, वे ऑनलाइन कैटलॉग से अवतार के कपड़े और एक्सेसरीज़ के साथ-साथ प्रीमियम बिल्डिंग मटीरियल, इंटरैक्टिव कंपोनेंट्स और वर्किंग मैकेनिज़्म खरीद सकते हैं।
